title: Jabberwocky
summary: A first-person maze crawler where the only weapon is the Jabberwocky rifle, and every pull of the trigger fires something different: a hail of knives, a frozen pie, a freight train, a herring, somebody's grandma. One hundred gags across four tiers (it kills / it works, oddly / a dud / it hurts you), four mazes and a boss in the middle with a rifle exactly like yours. Scars stay on the floor until you leave the level. Three odd doors in every maze are the ways out.
